title: neoalsomitra tonkinensis
intro: Neoalsomitra tonkinensis, commonly known as the Tonkin vine, is a plant species in the family Capparaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, offering numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, saponins, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
